request: implement important label for added tasks

spec.title: Star mark for important tasks
spec.summary: Add a small 'Important' checkbox to the add-task form. When checked, the created task is stored as important and shown with a ★ next to its title in the task list. Importance is set only at creation time; nothing else about the app changes.
acceptance: The add-task form shows a checkbox labeled 'Important' next to the title input.
Submitting the form with the checkbox checked creates a task that is stored as important.
Submitting the form with the checkbox unchecked (default) creates a task that is not important, same as today.
Tasks marked important display a ★ next to their title in the task list.
Tasks not marked important show no star, same as today.
After adding a task, the Important checkbox resets to unchecked, matching the existing title-reset behavior.
unchanged: Task list ordering (still by id, ascending).
Marking a task done/undone via the existing checkbox.
Seeded demo tasks (Task A, Task B, Renew the domain) and their done states.
Overall page layout, styling of the form/button, and colors aside from the new star.
No way to edit importance after a task is created.
spec.check: npm run setup (or the app's existing setup script) resets the seed DB, then start the app, add a task with 'Important' checked and one without; confirm only the first shows a ★, existing done-toggle and list behavior are unaffected.
spec.reviewFocus: Verify the important flag is persisted correctly via the API/DB, the star only renders when the flag is true, and no existing task behavior (done toggle, ordering, seed data) is altered.

findings.note: toListItem() builds each list item; will need to append a ★ span when task.important is true. Form submit handler builds POST body from titleInput.value; needs to also read a new important checkbox and include it in the JSON body, then reset the checkbox alongside titleInput.
The #new-task form only has a title input and Add button; needs a new checkbox input (e.g. #important) with a visible label.

POST /api/tasks only inserts title and hardcodes done=0; needs to also accept and store an optional important flag. GET/PATCH responses already return full rows via SELECT *, so a new column will flow through automatically once added to the schema.

CREATE TABLE tasks defines columns id, title, done; needs a new 'important' column (INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0). Existing insert.run calls only pass title/done, so they'll default to not important, keeping seed data unchanged.
No existing style for a star/badge; a minimal inline star character avoids needing new CSS, but a tiny style rule could be added if visual polish is desired (kept optional/minimal per user request).
